disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. Do not attribute Platinum, Signature, or Luxura benefits to this parser fallback.

joining.summary: Joining fees in the MITC include nil on Visa Classic, Visa Platinum, RuPay Platinum, and PQCC digital issuance, ₹1,500 on Visa Signature, and other product rows. Do not apply Platinum ₹500 annual or Signature fees here.

annual.summary: Annual fees include nil on Visa Classic, ₹300 on Visa Gold with usage conditions, ₹500 on Visa Platinum and RuPay Platinum, and ₹2,000 on Visa Signature.

annual_waiver.summary: Waiver rules are product-specific. Visa Signature waives on ₹3 lakh spends. RuPay Platinum waives if used once each quarter.

forex.summary: Forex markup is product-specific in the MITC.

base_earn.summary: Earn rates were not found in the first 800 lines of the MITC extract and are per variant.

redemption.summary: Bank-wide redemption starts from 1,000 points via creditcard.pnb.bank.in or support@pnbrewardz.com. A ₹0.25 per point example appears only in a negative-balance closure illustration and may vary by variant.

expiry.summary: Point expiry is product-specific. Points forfeit on closure or delinquency.

summary.summary: Luxura has lounge. The bank may restrict cards used only for lounge. Platinum lounge is unknown in the MITC extract. Do not assume lounge or Priority Pass on this fallback.

milestones.summary: Spend milestones are product-specific. Milestone spends typically exclude fees, forex, GST, fuel surcharge, late payment, interest, rent surcharge, and cheque bounce.

welcome.summary: Welcome benefits are product-specific. PQCC issues nil joining for eligible existing PNB customers.
